metadata.question: Is Lake Langano more brown than Lake Abijata in March 29, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need Sentinel-2 or Landsat imagery for March 29, 2022 - Lake Langano and Lake Abijata are in Ethiopia - Need to define geometries for both lakes - Will use Sentinel-2 first (better spatial resolution for "brownness" assessment) 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want to assess actual water color - Use cloud probability or QA bands 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - "Brownness" can be assessed using red/green bands or a brown index - A higher red/green ratio or lower blue band typically indicates browner water - Valid zero would be extremely blue water (unlikely for brown assessment) - Need to check if images exist, if pixels are valid after masking - Compare brownness metrics between the two lakes ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Lake geometries in Ethiopia const lakeLangano = ee.Geometry.Point([38.7, 7.6]).buffer(3000); const lakeAbijata = ee.Geometry.Point([38.6, 7.62]).buffer(3000); const date = '2022-03-29'; const startDate = '2022-03-25'; const endDate = '2022-04-02'; // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get Sentinel-2 imagery let colLangano = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeLangano) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskS2clouds); let colAbijata = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeAbijata) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskS2clouds); const sizeLangano = colLangano.size().getInfo(); const sizeAbijata = colAbijata.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Langano images: ${sizeLangano}, Abijata images: ${sizeAbijata}`); if (sizeLangano === 0 || sizeAbijata === 0) { console.log("Trying Landsat 8/9 fallback..."); colLangano = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeLangano) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); colAbijata = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeAbijata) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); if (colLangano.size().getInfo() === 0 || colAbijata.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log("No data available for one or both lakes."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // Composite images const imgLangano = colLangano.median(); const imgAbijata = colAbijata.median(); // Calculate brownness index (Red/Blue ratio - higher = browner) const brownLangano = imgLangano.select('B4').divide(imgLangano.select('B2')); const brownAbijata = imgAbijata.select('B4').divide(imgAbijata.select('B2')); // Check pixel counts const countLangano = brownLangano.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeLangano, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); const countAbijata = brownAbijata.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeAbijata, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - Langano: ${countLangano}, Abijata: ${countAbijata}`); if (countLangano === 0 || countAbijata === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Get mean brownness values const brownValLangano = brownLangano.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: lakeLangano, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); const brownValAbijata = brownAbijata.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: lakeAbijata, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); console.log(`Brownness - Langano: ${brownValLangano}, Abijata: ${brownValAbijata}`); if (brownValLangano === null || brownValAbijata === null || isNaN(brownValLangano) || isNaN(brownValAbijata)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (brownValLangano > brownValAbijata) { console.log("Lake Langano is more brown than Lake Abijata."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Lake Langano is NOT more brown than Lake Abijata."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
